- Latency target: p95 end-to-end < 250ms for text responses; streaming start token < 80ms desirable.

- POC ask: example streaming integration, sample p95 latency numbers for 512-token sequences, workload sizing guide, and an estimated monthly cost at 50k messages.
- Proposed POC plan: 1) use hosted API trial keys + streaming example; 2) run 48h soak at expected concurrency; 3) collect telemetry (p50/p95/p99, cost/token); 4) decide by end of April.
- Internal notes: likely self-serve qualify -> conversion if SLOs match and cost within range. AE Alex to share Optimize tips (batch windows, prefix caching) and short checklist for SOC2 doc request.
- Stacked links: pricing deck + quickstart included in drive.redwood/pricing/fernloft-quickstart.pdf.
